items.title: Tyler Huntley: Starting Sunday vs. Cincinnati
items.text:
With Lamar Jackson (ankle) being downgraded to out, Huntley will be the Ravens' starting quarterback against the Bengals on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Won't return for Week 7
items.text:

items.title: Dallas Goedert: Optimistic about knee injury
items.text:
